model: Dovecot POP3 (Alpine 3.20 packages dovecot / dovecot-pop3d 2.3.21.1-r0, OpenSSL 3.3.7), port 110, ssl=yes

capture.setup: lab PKI: the batch-1 container-lab root (RSA 4096, SHA-384) with its RSA 2048 and ECDSA P-384 issuing CAs, leaves issued with OpenSSL 3.5.5 in registry.access.redhat.com/ubi9/ubi@sha256:a729da793c5f57633fc0dfbe99ced541aedde3ea653d5344af5aabb49f5aeb89: leaf mail.fxlab.test RSA 2048, SHA-256, 365 days (SAN mail/smtp/imap.fxlab.test, 127.0.0.1) under the RSA issuing CA; ssl_cert=</certs/mail-chain.crt (leaf + intermediate); container on the dedicated fxlab-g Docker network, plaintext port published on 127.0.0.1
capture.command: certificate.ProbeStartTLS(host 127.0.0.1, port 12110 -> container :110, serverName imap.fxlab.test, protocol pop3) from the OpenMap certificate collector, run by a throwaway lab program through a recording TCP proxy; the presented chain (ConnectionState.PeerCertificates DER) PEM-encoded into chain.pem, version/cipher/verification into handshake.json, and every byte both sides exchanged before the client's first TLS record into dialogue.server.bin / dialogue.client.bin with the turn order and sizes in dialogue.json

files.name: chain.pem
files.description: certificate chain exactly as presented after the StartTLS upgrade (leaf first), PEM of the DER bytes

files.name: handshake.json
files.description: StartTLS protocol, endpoint port, negotiated TLS version and cipher, SNI and the verification result against the capture host's system roots

files.name: dialogue.server.bin
files.description: plaintext bytes the server sent before the TLS handshake, unchanged

files.name: dialogue.client.bin
files.description: plaintext bytes the collector sent before the TLS handshake, unchanged

files.name: dialogue.json
files.description: turn order of the plaintext dialogue (who spoke, how many bytes)

files.name: lab-root-ca.crt
files.description: public certificate of the lab root CA (not presented by the server; the trust anchor for chain verification)
